Tango Card
Thank you for your valuable participation in our research study. We sincerely appreciate the time and effort you dedicated to this endeavor. As a token of our gratitude, please find attached a $50 e-gift card as our way of expressing thanks for your commitment and contribution to our work.
To redeem your reward, please follow these steps:
  1. Copy security code: 52VPD716
  2. Click on the redemption URL and paste the security code to unlock the reward.
Please note that this is not the same code used for your purchase.
Redemption URL: https://codes.rewardcodes.com/r2/1/cJZaqW9scAGyttsiBO80FDWYjp-EsOLETE7tsApy5CmSqv1bLre_pn3otEPUXeZr
3. Once unlocked, the reward code will be revealed.
Best regards,
Dr. Tempestt Neal
Director, Cyber Identity and Behavior Research (CIBeR) Lab
Associate Professor, Department of Computer Science and Engineering
